summary: Emerging role that designs and stewards field reference data and validation samples for remote, modelled and AI-generated products, codes the field causes of mismatch, calibrates observers and states whether a product is fit for a stated use.
evidenceNotice: Reshaping claims are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). No task has a v2 multi-rater assessment yet, so every task shows 'assessment pending'. Change indicators count active signals only (ADR-0028); all linked signals are at watch, so no change indicator moves. v1 values appear only as prior-evidence pointers.

roleLevelChange.note: Validation of remote and AI products is forming as a distinct responsibility; no dedicated federal series exists (X4 NoTermFound).
